title: Insulin Pharmacy Formulary Listing: Preferred Insulins by Tier
content:
Each tier of the Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program has its own preferred formulary list of insulin items; other insulins need an approved formulary exception.

## Preferred list by tier

| Insulin item | Self-Pay | Commercial HMO | Commercial PPO | Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug | Medicare Part D | Medicare Part B Pump Insulin | Medicaid |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Insulin lispro, 10 mL vial | Preferred | Preferred | — | — | Preferred | — | Preferred |
| Insulin aspart, 10 mL vial | Preferred | — | Preferred | Preferred | Preferred | — | — |
| Insulin lispro pens, box of five 3 mL pens | Preferred | Preferred | Preferred | Preferred | — | — | — |
| Insulin glargine pens, box of five 3 mL pens | Preferred | Preferred | Preferred | Preferred | Preferred | — | Preferred |
| Insulin degludec pens, box of five 3 mL pens | Preferred | — | Preferred | — | Preferred | — | — |
| Human regular insulin, 10 mL vial | Preferred | — | — | Preferred | — | — | Preferred |
| J1817 pump insulin (billing unit of 50 units of insulin) | — | — | — | — | — | Preferred | — |

The column headings are the Insulin Pharmacy Self-Pay Program, Insulin Pharmacy Commercial HMO Program, Insulin Pharmacy Commercial PPO Program, Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug Program, Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part D Program, Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part B Pump Insulin Program and Insulin Pharmacy Medicaid Program. A dash means the item is not on that tier's preferred list.

## The same lists, read tier by tier

- **Insulin Pharmacy Self-Pay Program:** insulin lispro 10 mL vial; insulin aspart 10 mL vial; insulin lispro pens; insulin glargine pens; insulin degludec pens; human regular insulin 10 mL vial.
- **Insulin Pharmacy Commercial HMO Program:** insulin lispro 10 mL vial; insulin lispro pens; insulin glargine pens.
- **Insulin Pharmacy Commercial PPO Program:** insulin aspart 10 mL vial; insulin lispro pens; insulin glargine pens; insulin degludec pens.
- **Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug Program:** insulin aspart 10 mL vial; insulin lispro pens; insulin glargine pens; human regular insulin 10 mL vial.
- **Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part D Program:** insulin lispro 10 mL vial; insulin aspart 10 mL vial; insulin glargine pens; insulin degludec pens.
- **Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part B Pump Insulin Program:** J1817 pump insulin only.
- **Insulin Pharmacy Medicaid Program:** insulin lispro 10 mL vial; insulin glargine pens; human regular insulin 10 mL vial.

Insulin glargine pens are the one item preferred on every tier except the Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part B Pump Insulin Program.

## Backup supplies for pump users

Every tier is marked **Yes** for backup supplies: a pump user's backup pens or vials with syringes may be dispensed on a Part D or MA-PD program alongside the Part B pump insulin program.

| Tier | Backup pens or vials with syringes for pump users |
|---|---|
| Insulin Pharmacy Self-Pay Program | Yes |
| Insulin Pharmacy Commercial HMO Program | Yes |
| Insulin Pharmacy Commercial PPO Program | Yes |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug Program | Yes |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part D Program | Yes |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part B Pump Insulin Program | Yes |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicaid Program | Yes |
